settings.info: Empty = line hidden.

settings.content: Cart add-ons. Each must be an UNLISTED product with 'requires shipping' off, published to the Online Store only — never to Google & YouTube, or it enters the Shopping feed as a product.

settings.label: Cart add-on 1 (product handle)
settings.info: e.g. shipping-protection. A handle, not a picker: unlisted products are invisible to a product picker in Liquid. Empty = row hidden.

settings.label: Cart add-on 2 (product handle)
settings.info: e.g. priority-shipping. Empty = row hidden.

settings.content: Add-ons must not be pre-selected by default: a pre-ticked paid add-on is an additional payment under Art. 22 Consumer Rights Directive 2011/83/EU and requires the shopper's express opt-in before checkout — pre-selection may only be enabled for markets where it is lawful. Each add-on must stay a clearly labelled, separately priced cart line the shopper can add in one click — that is what keeps an opt-in add-on from being a hidden fee.

settings.label: Pre-select cart add-ons
settings.info: A pre-ticked paid add-on is not valid consent for an additional payment under Art. 22 Consumer Rights Directive 2011/83/EU, and carries similar risk under other consumer-protection regimes (e.g. FTC). Adds both add-ons the first time a real product enters the bag, if turned on; a shopper who unticks or removes one is never asked again in that session. Both stay visible, priced and removable above the total — keep it that way, a hidden pre-ticked paid add-on is a chargeback and compliance risk.

settings.label: Cart reservation countdown (minutes)
settings.info: 0 = no countdown. Nothing is actually reserved (inventory is untracked). A fabricated reservation countdown is a fake-urgency dark pattern under consumer-protection law in many jurisdictions, the same class as the id-modulo scarcity line. Re-enable only if the countdown is backed by genuine inventory-hold logic.

settings.content: Rating shown above the product title and under the checkout button. These are hand-entered numbers — the theme never links to or scrapes an external review profile.

settings.label: Rating value
settings.info: Printed as-is next to the stars. Empty = the whole rating row is hidden everywhere.

settings.label: Review count
settings.info: Printed as-is, e.g. "1,284". Empty = only the value shows.

settings.content: Urgency + social-proof lines. These are NOT read from live inventory (inventory is untracked, policy CONTINUE) — they are fixed copy by design. Empty = the line does not render.

settings.label: Low-stock line
settings.default: Almost sold out, only a few left in stock

settings.label: Stack & save line
settings.default: Stack & save — buy more, get a bigger discount

settings.content: Trust box under the add button, and the ✔ promise lines. Copy stays GMC-safe fact — no guarantee we do not actually honour.
Central on/off switches for every urgency, proof and helper element. Each element also hides when its text setting is emptied. The urgency switches ship OFF and stay off by default.

settings.label: Fit scale (PDP)
settings.info: Runs small / true to size / runs large marker, derived from custom.fit_note (override: custom.fit_scale). Renders nothing when no verdict can be derived.

settings.label: Newsletter popup
settings.info: Theme-owned newsletter popup (8s trigger, 30-day dismiss memory). ⚠️ Any discount promise in the popup copy REQUIRES a matching real discount in the store (fake-signal rule). Ships off by default: known issue where mobile lets you scroll it away — fix scroll-lock before re-enabling.

settings.label: Hide cart add-on lines
settings.info: The paid add-on (shipping protection) then appears ONLY as its toggle row, never as a cart line. Its price stays visible on the toggle and in the total.

settings.content: ⚠️ URGENCY SWITCHES. Everything below fakes a live signal (inventory is untracked). Turning any of these on without a real data basis is a GMC-misrepresentation and dark-pattern risk under consumer-protection law in many jurisdictions. They exist as switches so each store can be configured individually; they are NOT meant to be enabled by default.

settings.label: Scarcity line (PDP) — ⚠️ fake urgency
settings.info: id-modulo pseudo scarcity (red/amber/green). Off by default: enable only with real inventory gating.

settings.label: Live-viewers line (PDP) — ⚠️ fake signal
settings.info: Deterministic pseudo-random count, no real data behind it.

settings.label: Star rating (PDP + cart) — ⚠️ needs a real source
settings.info: Prints the hand-entered rating_value/rating_count from Storefront proof. OFF until a genuine review base backs the numbers — fabricated ratings breach consumer-protection law (e.g. DSA Art. 25, FTC).

settings.label: Cart drawer: express wallets
settings.info: Shows Shop Pay / Google Pay express buttons under the checkout button in the cart drawer. Off = calmer drawer, wallets still available in checkout.

settings.label: Enable bundle-discount bar
settings.info: Shows the tier bar in the cart drawer + cart page and the ladder on the PDP. ONLY enable after the matching Shopify automatic discounts are live — the bar is display-only and must mirror what checkout actually grants, or it is misrepresentation (GMC suspension risk).

settings.content: Your ToolSuite membership license. This is pre-filled when you download the theme from your ToolSuite dashboard. Manage it at toolsuite.com/dashboard/resources.

settings.label: License key
